question: At the calibrated S body, is the ambiguous DIRECT/STAGED result at 5000 ns resolved by the follower-idle interaction, including the existing 15000 ns S-row baseline?

bodyTreatment.reasonForRefinement: Experiment 32 produced only five STAGED wins in eight 5000 ns block pairs, with a signed range from -3881929 to 3850613 ops/s. That is not sufficiently repeatable to collapse the S row into the M/H conclusion.

requiredCalculations: At each idle duration, compute the block-paired STAGED-minus-DIRECT throughput effect with mean, median, sample standard deviation, range, percentage delta, and win count.
Within DIRECT, compute block-paired idle responses using 0 ns as the reference.
Within STAGED, compute block-paired idle responses using the existing S-row 15000 ns treatment as the reference.
Report treatment means and sample CV across the eight independent JVM replicas.
Report within-replica CV without treating measurement iterations as independent forks.
Rank the full action-by-idle surface by throughput, repeatability, and absence of severe block regressions.
Evaluate acquisition success, contention centroid, idle fraction, and throughput jointly to identify active-pool effects.
Classify every state-22-dominant measurement while keeping throughput as the primary ranking metric.
Compare the new 5000 ns result with Experiment 32 as a separate reproducibility check; do not pool the two experiment batches.
interpretationRules: Do not call the Experiment 32 S-body result a common STAGED relationship; its action effect was not repeatable across blocks.
Treat action and follower idle as an interaction surface rather than selecting either factor from pooled marginal means.
Prefer a broad robust region over a fragile single-point maximum when treatments are within noise.
If one action wins consistently across useful idle durations, carry that S-row action/idle region forward alongside the established M/H STAGED evidence.
If the action winner depends on idle, preserve an S-body-specific coupled row and name only the minimum local refinement needed around the crossover or winning interval.
If the S row remains unresolved because of multistability, do not proceed to topology sensitivity; identify the smallest additional S-row replication or diagnostic needed.
Do not add XS/XH, skip, P-core, topology, or threshold treatments in this experiment.
State 22 remains explanatory telemetry, not the primary ranking target.
stopRule: Stop after resolving or precisely classifying the S-body action/idle interaction and naming the minimum justified next step. Do not configure or execute topology, P-core, skip, endpoint-body, or contention-threshold work.
